records.title: On the matrices of given rank in a large subspace
records.evidence_read: Theorem9, Proposition10 and their proofs; arbitrary-field hypothesis checked, including F2.
records.mechanism: Trivial-spectrum dimension bound via induction and a directed elementary-matrix cycle.
records.problem_family: Linear spaces of matrices and affine full-rank matrix spaces over arbitrary fields.
records.reduction: An all-nonsingular affine n-by-n pivot pencil has variation dimension at most n(n-1)/2.
records.no_go_barrier: A lower dimension does not imply a nonsingular translate, useful native coverage or higher-carry closure.
records.proof_technique: Induction on matrix dimension; a zero row-supported subspace enables the rank bound.
records.open_question: Can native binary code products produce an efficiently selected pencil satisfying the necessary bound and sufficient nonsingularity conditions?
records.reusable_abstraction: Keep arbitrary-field dimension bounds separate from field-size-qualified classifications.

records.title: Constructive noncommutative rank computation is in deterministic polynomial time
records.evidence_read: Current abstract only; sufficiently-large-base-field requirement checked.
records.mechanism: Constructive matrix-space rank certificates with controlled tensor blow-up.
records.problem_family: Noncommutative rank over sufficiently large fields.
records.reduction: Potential operator-space abstraction, not a proved algorithm for binary prescribed-dimension pivot spans.
records.no_go_barrier: Field extension, binary descent, exact dimension constraints and nonsingular affine coverage are separate unresolved requirements.
records.proof_technique: Author-described regularity and blow-up reduction; full theorem review pending.
records.open_question: Which certificate, if any, transfers to the actual F2 carry-polar operator family without changing access or dimensions?
records.reusable_abstraction: Export the full operator family, not selected matrix columns alone.

records.title: Shrunk subspaces via operator Sinkhorn iteration
records.mechanism: Operator scaling with marginal majorization and rounding of approximate shrunk subspaces.
records.problem_family: Minimum shrunk subspaces over the complex field.
records.reduction: Possible conceptual relation to subspace expansion; prescribed binary W and all-background inversion are not supplied.
records.no_go_barrier: Low Schur-product dimension is not automatically a shrunk subspace, and complex certificates need not descend to binary spans.
records.proof_technique: Author-described Sinkhorn iteration and rounding; full proof not audited.
records.open_question: Is there a source-valid finite-field expansion certificate applicable to this actual code-product problem?
records.reusable_abstraction: Track base field, tensor blow-up, approximate versus exact certificates and dimension promises.
